ui.title: Configured hooks ({count})
ui.actions: Space toggle built-in (empty search) · Ctrl+R refresh · Ctrl+E edit Cognia · Ctrl+L edit Claude
ui.search: Search name, event, source or command

data.empty: No user hooks configured. Edit a source file to add hooks.
data.external: Configuration inventory. External agents do not receive Cognia SDK lifecycle hooks. Local CLI events can still run command hooks; the external agent may also have its own hook configuration.
data.otherProvider: Configured hooks only. The current non-Anthropic built-in provider does not run the SDK lifecycle-hook pipeline.
data.configured: Configuration inventory, not execution history. Reload after editing; changes apply to a fresh agent context on the next message.
data.toggleHelp: Space toggles this built-in hook. Custom hooks are edited in their source files; no commands are executed by this panel.
data.busy: Finish or stop the current response before changing or reloading hooks.
data.reloaded: Hooks reloaded. The next message starts a fresh agent context; the visible transcript remains.
data.saveFailed: Could not save hook configuration. The setting was not changed.
data.edited: Editor closed: {path}. Press Ctrl+R to validate and reload hooks.
data.editFailed: Could not finish editing {path}. Check your /editor configuration.
